method: Read-only catalog/knowledge/model audit. Exact-SKU explicit evidence only; no sibling inheritance or runtime/attachment claim. All 217 items inventoried; not all hardware source docs independently revalidated.

conditions: Explicitly physical connector, not USB peripheral mode or a separate downloader.
Exact product identifies Grove as HY2.0-4P; generic four-pin wiring is insufficient.

doNotMerge.reason: Grove and 1.0 mm JST-SH/Qwiic are mechanically different. Qwiic convention is not generic JST-SH pin order; verify exact SKU.
Unpopulated pads are not sockets; pitch, pin count, contact side and signal mapping must match independently.
Pitch alone omits row/count/gender/keying. Bare pads and populated headers differ.
BTB is an assembly family. Stamp-P4 AXE516127D and HC-PBB40C-20DS-0.4V-2.5-02 are not interchangeable by type equality.
Unknown USB shape stays unknown. USB-A power-only does not imply USB Host.
Signals/protocols cannot stand in for an independently verified physical connector.

uiRules: Filter physical external interfaces with external === true. Internal false never enters external options.
Empty arrays and internal-only metadata mean external interface information pending, unless explicit no-external-connector fact exists.
Selecting a product must rebuild options from that product and reset stale selection; do not infer device ports from accessory catalog.
Type filter is a browse filter, not a compatibility/auto-wiring claim. Ports of same type can have different signals and voltage.
Unknown GPIO/USB family entries and FPC-pad may be shown as incomplete/non-pluggable physical information, but should not match ready-to-plug accessories.
Explicit browse-all is useful when the device has no known matching official accessories; keep attachment validation separate.
